Elden Ring equipment load and rolling

Game: Elden Ring.

In Elden Ring, heavy rolling depends on equipment load. To avoid heavy rolling, keep your equipped weight below 70 percent of your maximum equipment load. Unequip a heavy weapon or armor piece to lower the load. Items merely carried in inventory do not contribute to equipped weight. Check the equipment screen after changing gear. This is a base-game equipment-load mechanic.
